metadata.title: Enterprise Software Development Security Controls Catalog
metadata.remarks: Security control catalog for software development and deployment in regulated industries. This catalog defines foundational security controls applicable to enterprise software projects.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall develop, document, and disseminate access control policies that address purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, and compliance requirements for information systems.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall manage system accounts including creation, modification, enabling, disabling, and removal of accounts with appropriate authorization.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system shall enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources based on applicable access control policies.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized access for users (or processes acting on behalf of users) which are necessary to accomplish assigned tasks.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system shall generate audit records for system events, configuration changes, security-relevant events including authentication attempts, and access control decisions.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Audit records shall contain information that establishes: what type of event occurred, when the event occurred, where the event occurred, the source of the event, the outcome of the event, and the identity of any individuals or subjects associated with the event.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall review and analyze information system audit records for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity, investigate suspicious activity or suspected violations, and report findings to designated organizational officials.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system shall provide audit record generation capability for auditable events and allow authorized personnel to select which auditable events are to be audited by specific components.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall develop, document, and maintain baseline configurations for information systems including software components, dependencies, and security configurations.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall determine configuration changes to information systems, review proposed changes for security impacts, document configuration change decisions, and implement approved configuration changes through validated change control processes.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall establish and document configuration settings for information systems using security configuration checklists that reflect the most restrictive mode consistent with operational requirements.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall develop and document an inventory of information system components including software modules, dependencies, and third-party libraries, and update the inventory as part of component installations, removals, and updates.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system shall uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users accessing the system through appropriate authentication mechanisms.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall manage information system authenticators including initial authenticator distribution, establishing minimum authenticator strength requirements, and protecting authenticator content from unauthorized disclosure and modification.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system shall monitor and control communications at external boundaries and key internal boundaries, implementing network isolation for different security domains.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system shall protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information through encryption when communicating with external services and systems.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system shall implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect sensitive information at rest and in transit using FIPS-validated cryptographic modules where applicable.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system shall protect the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive information at rest including credentials, configuration files, and assessment data.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall identify, report, and correct information system flaws through systematic flaw remediation processes including security vulnerability scanning and patch management.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall implement malicious code protection mechanisms including scanning downloaded software, configuration files, and dependencies from external sources.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall monitor information systems to detect attacks, unauthorized access attempts, and indicators of potential attacks, and identify unauthorized use of the system.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system shall employ integrity verification tools and techniques to detect unauthorized changes to software, firmware, and information including component validation, dependency verification, and code signing.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system shall check the validity of user inputs including command arguments, configuration files, and structured documents to prevent injection attacks and ensure data integrity.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall manage information systems using a system development life cycle that incorporates information security considerations throughout all phases.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall require developers to perform configuration management during system development, including tracking security flaws and flaw resolution, and managing component dependencies.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall require developers to create and implement security test and evaluation plans including static analysis, dynamic analysis, and security validation testing.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall require developers to follow documented development processes, standards, and use approved development tools that ensure code quality and security.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall develop, document, and disseminate privacy policies and procedures that address the collection, use, retention, and disposal of personal data in compliance with applicable regulations including GDPR.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall implement data minimization principles to ensure that only personal data necessary for specified purposes is collected, processed, and retained.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall obtain, record, and manage user consent for the collection and processing of personal data, providing mechanisms for users to withdraw consent at any time.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall implement processes to support data subject rights including the right to access, rectification, erasure, data portability, and objection to processing of personal data.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall conduct privacy impact assessments for systems and processes that involve the collection, use, or disclosure of personal data, particularly when introducing new technologies or processing methods.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall ensure that transfers of personal data to third countries or international organizations comply with applicable legal frameworks including adequacy decisions, standard contractual clauses, or binding corporate rules.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall classify AI systems according to their risk level (unacceptable, high, limited, minimal) based on the EU AI Act framework and implement appropriate controls for each risk category.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall ensure AI systems provide appropriate transparency, including disclosure when users are interacting with AI systems, and implement explainability mechanisms for high-risk AI applications.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall implement data governance practices for AI training datasets, including data quality assurance, bias detection and mitigation, and documentation of data sources and characteristics.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall establish validation and testing procedures for AI models including accuracy assessment, fairness testing, robustness evaluation, and ongoing monitoring of model performance.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall implement appropriate human oversight mechanisms for high-risk AI systems, ensuring that humans can intervene, override, or halt AI decisions when necessary.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall maintain comprehensive documentation for AI systems including intended purpose, capabilities, limitations, training data, model architecture, performance metrics, and known risks.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization shall establish incident response procedures for AI systems to detect, report, and remediate harmful or unintended behavior, including mechanisms for user feedback and continuous improvement.
